summary: The pattern is an assembly: it only works when the deterministic layer, the verdict layer, the durable record and the post-integration sweep are all present.

items.text: Run the review itself as named gates with documented standards and structured pass, fail or advisory verdicts — the artifact the human actually reads instead of the diff.
Anchor the deterministic layer: build, tests and checks that fail without a model in the loop and therefore cannot be argued with.
Model the delivery path as explicit stages with pass criteria so that 'before the integration merge' is a real, versioned position rather than a habit.
Re-home the audit trail the pull request used to carry: platform-owned task history, authority grants and evidence that the delivering agent cannot rewrite.
Give the verdict a stable shape — findings, severity, evidence pointers, follow-up tasks — so operators can triage a stream of them.
Cover what per-change gates structurally cannot see with periodic sweeps across the integrated codebase.
Keep human attention on results rather than on the working phase: the operator inspects the outcome, not the agent at work.
